## MegaDock

Run rigid protein–protein docking with the active MEGADOCK-GPU v2 backend.

Exact job name: `MegaDock`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ligand_path` | string | yes | file | ZIP containing ligand PDB structures. |
| `receptor_path` | string | yes | file | One receptor PDB structure. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "ligand_path": {
      "description": "ZIP containing ligand PDB structures.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "receptor_path": {
      "description": "One receptor PDB structure.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "ligand_path",
    "receptor_path"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.

## Placer

Place a named ligand in a protein structure, generate candidate poses, and rank the poses by a supported confidence metric.

Exact job name: `Placer`.

### Inputs

Fields below belong in `experiment_data`; `experiment_name` is supplied separately.

| Field | Type | Required | Input kind | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input_file_path` | string | yes | file | Uploaded .pdb or .cif path. The native PDB parser requires protein and non-water ligand chains to be distinct. Prepare a reviewed copy with separate ligand chain labels and matching predict_ligand; do not silently relabel or change coordinates. |
| `rerank` | string | yes | value | Exact value `prmsd`, `plddt`, or `plddt_pde`. |
| `suffix` | string | yes | value | Ligand identifier appended to outputs; must match `^[A-Z]+-[A-Z]+-\d+$`, for example `D-LDP-501`. |
| `predict_ligand` | string | yes | value | Exact ligand identifier in the input structure, including chain ID, 3-letter ligand name, and residue number; same format as `suffix`. |
| `no_of_samples` | integer | yes | value | Number of poses; minimum 10 and maximum 100. Send an integer, not a string. |

Input kinds: `value` is inline data; `file` requires a platform file reference;
`file_or_value` supports either documented mode; `artifact` is an authorized upstream result reference.
Only local files require a new upload. Never infer input mode from a field name.

### Exact request schema

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "input_file_path": {
      "description": "Uploaded .pdb or .cif path. The native PDB parser requires protein and non-water ligand chains to be distinct. Prepare a reviewed copy with separate ligand chain labels and matching predict_ligand; do not silently relabel or change coordinates.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "file"
    },
    "rerank": {
      "description": "Exact value `prmsd`, `plddt`, or `plddt_pde`.",
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "prmsd",
        "plddt",
        "plddt_pde"
      ],
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    },
    "suffix": {
      "description": "Ligand identifier appended to outputs; must match `^[A-Z]+-[A-Z]+-\\d+$`, for example `D-LDP-501`.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "pattern": "^[A-Z]+-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+$"
    },
    "predict_ligand": {
      "description": "Exact ligand identifier in the input structure, including chain ID, 3-letter ligand name, and residue number; same format as `suffix`.",
      "type": "string",
      "x-input-kind": "value",
      "pattern": "^[A-Z]+-[A-Z]+-[0-9]+$"
    },
    "no_of_samples": {
      "description": "Number of poses; minimum 10 and maximum 100. Send an integer, not a string.",
      "type": "integer",
      "x-input-kind": "value"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "input_file_path",
    "rerank",
    "suffix",
    "predict_ligand",
    "no_of_samples"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

### Submission envelope

Shape only: replace placeholders with the user's values. This is not a runnable sample.
```json
{
  "job_name": "Placer",
  "experiment_name": "<confirmed experiment name>",
  "experiment_data": {
    "input_file_path": "<user value; see input_file_path schema>",
    "rerank": "<user value; see rerank schema>",
    "suffix": "<user value; see suffix schema>",
    "predict_ligand": "<user value; see predict_ligand schema>",
    "no_of_samples": "<user value; see no_of_samples schema>"
  }
}
```

For mode-dependent fields, include the fields required by the selected schema branch.

### File checks

```json
{
  "input_file_path": {
    "formats": [
      "pdb",
      "cif"
    ],
    "header_case_sensitive": true,
    "notes": "Platform path returned by `file_upload`; filename must end in `.pdb` or `.cif`.",
    "structure_profile": "protein_structure",
    "ligand_field": "predict_ligand",
    "pdb_separate_ligand_chains": true,
    "validation_context": [
      "predict_ligand"
    ]
  }
}
```
